profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space industry. Skilled in Visual Studio, C#, PostgreSQL. Proficient at self-motivated, collaborating and solving problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: AngularJS · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · C# · API Development · SQL Server Management Studio · ASP.NET · Application Development · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop the business and presentation layer of a data analyzing application for processing and manipulat-
ing large (gigabyte) datasets. This application was injected into a parent shell application using MEF and included services usable via dependency injection by all other applications within the shell. The core technologies used are C#7, .Net Framework 4.7.2 / Standard 2, WPF, PostgreSQL.
• Perform unit testing, debugging and bug fixing.
• Assist in installing, testing, and troubleshooting hardware and applications to ensure integration with
product deployments.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed an application to provide simulated GPS to custom hardware via UDP broadcasts.
• Gained good understanding of Internet Protocol (TCP/UDP). The technologies used were C#, WPF, Wireshark, Putty, WinSCP.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: • Collaborated with professors and Civil Engineering students in design, development, testing, implementation and production support of a traffic map evaluation tool. The technologies used were Java, Bitbucket, Microsoft Azure.

positions.title: Networking and Software Support
positions.description: • Contribute technical software and hardware support on a cloud platform for an enterprise accounting software. Integration of RDP scripts for group policies.

positions.title: Technical Support Intern
positions.description: • Assisted with on-boarding and provisioning co-location customers.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: • Academic liaison to Dean Department of Tourism and Hospitality and maintenance services
